thread:
deploy-bot: Promote attempt for service=notifier image=v2026-07-12 failed post-publish verify: expected=sha256:9f8e7d6c actual=sha256:9f8e7d00. Canary hold engaged.

samir: saw this in the 30m change window. publish job completed but verify failed immediately. logs show `multipart complete` returned 200 then verify mismatch.

kelly: i fetched the artifact and `sha256sum` matches actual=9f8e7d00. So index vs storage disagree. could be a truncated multipart part or a CI runner that re-uploaded halfway.

evan: i inspected the CI worker logs — there's a `rsync` retry on the artifact dir right before upload, and we had a worker restart. possible partial file got picked up for upload.

samir: options: 1) pin to last-good v2026-07-11 to keep change window moving, 2) force-promote (no), 3) rerun publish from a clean workspace now (risk repeating under pressure).

release-manager: prefer pin to last-good for minimal blast radius. open a follow-up ticket to harden publisher verification and add workspace cleanup in CI job.

kelly: immediate steps post-pin: create ARTIFACT-1705 to track CI workspace cleanup, publisher final-fetch verification, and add a `--atomic-upload` flag to publisher to avoid picking partial files.

sre-oncall: checking object-store logs for multipart finalize errors. no widespread S3 5xx, but a few failed completes in region-us-east-1 at 09:12. opening INC-2026-110 to correlate.

evan: quick mitigation: i'll trigger a controlled re-publish from a known-good CI artifact (build id 4821) that we verified in staging earlier. but i'd rather do that after pin so we don't affect the window.

deploy-bot: Usage: `deploybot pin --service notifier --image v2026-07-11 --reason "post-publish checksum mismatch v2026-07-12"`

samir: running pin now:
```
deploybot pin --service notifier --image v2026-07-11 --reason "post-publish checksum mismatch v2026-07-12"
```

deploy-bot: Pin successful. Canary reverted to v2026-07-11; traffic restored.

release-manager: updating release notes: "Canary for notifier (v2026-07-12) held due to artifact checksum mismatch between storage and index; pinned to v2026-07-11. ARTIFACT-1705 opened for remediation. INC-2026-110 created to monitor multipart finalize errors."

kelly: adding short-term CI change: before upload, verify file size+mtime and run `sha256sum` locally, then upload and verify after finalize. Add retry+backoff for multipart finalize. will PR to publisher tomorrow.

evan: i'll re-publish build 4821 to a temp key and run full verify; if good we'll schedule a safe canary reattempt outside this change window.

sre-oncall: will watch INC-2026-110 and post any further finalize error spikes.

release-manager: decision: pin applied for notifier only; do not block other services. remediation tracked in ARTIFACT-1705. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
